curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: Hadar.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR6366511 && mv data/SRR6366511_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR6366511_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: Hadar. Antigenic formula should match 8:z10:e,n,x.
validation_instructions.mlst: MLST sequence type not provided in validation panel. Accept any valid ST result from tool. Flag novel alleles for review.
